### Feasting on God's Word
Author: Carolyn Dale Newell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/feasting-on-god-s-word-encouragement-caf-january-13-2016.html
Passage: 2 Peter 3:18
Points:
- Spiritual growth requires regular nourishment from God's Word, just as physical life requires food.
- Faithful preaching provides essential spiritual intake and allows the Holy Spirit to bring conviction.
- Daily personal Bible study and verse meditation protect believers from spiritual starvation.
- Earthly trials function as growing pains that test our knowledge and highlight God's grace.
